observations: Mountain bike with a sloping top tube frame.
Twist-grip gear shifters on the handlebars.
Front and rear black plastic mudguards.
Rim brakes (V-brakes) visible on the front wheel.
Rear derailleur and multi-speed cassette visible.
Matte olive green or grey frame finish.
Visible dirt and signs of use on the lower fork legs and frame.
Flat pedals and a kickstand are installed.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows visible dirt, grime, and signs of wear on the fork and frame, which is inconsistent with 'perfect' condition.
Mechanical operation cannot be confirmed from a static photo.
Photo resolution is too low to inspect the chain, bolts, and cables for surface rust.

risks.risk: Gears or brakes may be seized or poorly indexed.
risks.proof: A video showing the bicycle shifting through all gears and the brakes stopping the wheels.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a full mechanical overhaul

risks.risk: Front suspension may be seized or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the front fork compressing and rebounding under weight.

risks.risk: The frame may have hidden cracks or structural damage.
risks.proof: Clear, high-resolution side-profile photos of the frame joints and tubes.

proof_requests: Clear side-on photo of the entire bicycle to identify the brand and frame condition.
Close-up photo of the drivetrain (chain and gears) to check for wear and rust.
Video of the gears shifting and brakes being applied.
Close-up of the brand and model name on the frame.
response.reason: The only comparable provided is for a motorcycle, which is a different category of vehicle and cannot be used to value a bicycle. No relevant bicycle price data is available.
